caption_review: All five captions (docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/sampled-profile-core-hold.html:14,15,27,28,29) do far more than repeat a title: they name the machine and frame, the arm order, the residuals, the 21 shared flux levels with their values, and what each marker family means, including that hollow markers are unconfined roots. They are not recorded as findings. One caption clause is not matched by the picture: the three midplane captions list dark crosses among the series ("Blue squares are head, grey circles base and dark crosses EFIT map") without saying those crosses appear only in the left panel, which is the finding recorded against scripts/prototypes/diiid_core_hold/render.py:234.

findings.anchor_note: the two draw_critical_points calls; the helper they reach, scripts/prototypes/diiid_xpoint_offset/render.py:29-57, marks each point once with no de-overlap, offset or leader, and the checked save of scripts/prototypes/diiid_xpoint_offset/style.py:16-35 validates text artists only, so overlapping markers pass the guard
findings.summary: In the base core zoom the seven in-plasma critical points are drawn on top of one another and read as two blue blobs. On this 1714x882 render the zoom axes are 326 px across a 1.525 m span (4.7 mm/px) and a 7 pt marker is about 12 px (about 56 mm), while the four maxima sit at x 668-676, y 333/351/438/454 and the three saddles at x 671-673, y 344/370/444: pairs are 7 and 11 px apart, so the top three markers (a maximum, a saddle and another maximum) merge into one mass and the lower pair merges into a second. The zoom exists precisely to separate these points and it cannot: a reader can neither count the four maxima the panel footer states nor tell a maximum from a saddle, so the base arm's headline result is stated in the text but not visible in the picture.

findings.anchor_note: the EFIT block guarded by `if i == 0`; the legend key is built unconditionally at :265
findings.summary: EFIT is plotted only under `if i == 0`, so the pressure-contribution and field-contribution panels of all three midplane figures carry no EFIT trace at all, while the figure-wide legend advertises an "EFIT map" key and each caption lists dark crosses as one of the three series without limiting them to the left panel. On the 1714x882 renders the two right axes contain zero near-black pixels inside their interiors, against 1826 (frame 137), 1906 (frame 146) and 2047 (MAST) in the left axes, so the absence is the drawing order and not an occluded trace. A reader of the component panels is left unable to tell whether EFIT's split agrees with the held source or whether the series is missing; qualifying the legend entry as left-panel-only, or drawing any available EFIT component in those panels, would remove the ambiguity.

findings.anchor_note: solved_style sets zorder_markers=12 and reference_style sets zorder_markers=15; the reference set is drawn second at :121-123
findings.summary: Where the solved and EFIT nulls nearly coincide, the reference markers are drawn at zorder 15 over the solved markers at zorder 12, so the solved marker's shape is erased rather than shown beside or beneath it. In the frame-137 head core zoom the solved maximum reads as a blue fringe under a black downward triangle, and in frame-146 the solved maximum is a blue fringe under a black plus that itself merges with an adjacent EFIT minimum square. Both colours remain visible, so the coincidence the panel is making is still conveyed, but neither marker's shape survives, so a reader cannot match the blue legend entries to what is drawn or tell a maximum from a saddle where the two codes disagree.

In the base core zoom the filled saddle at (671,365) and the filled minimum at (677,363) are 6 px apart against a 12 px marker, so a blue cross and a blue circle merge into a single mark and the reader cannot tell that two critical points, of different kinds, stand there. The three maxima and the other saddles remain individually readable, so the panel's stated maximum count can still be counted and the node is not held.
